verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms an llms.txt index at workable.readme.io/llms.txt (HTTP 200). Per-page Markdown versions of the docs are also served (e.g. generate-an-access-token.md), and they point agents back to the llms.txt index, so an agent can be pointed straight at agent-oriented docs. Missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all standard paths returned 404), and independent or community corroboration of agents actually using these docs.
